title: Initialize the base part
explanation: The convenience constructor delegates with this(...). The full constructor calls super(...). The first recorded event comes from LearningSession. This view shows a trace prefix, not an externally returned partly constructed object.

title: Complete the full constructor
explanation: After the base constructor returns, FocusedSession validates minutes, assigns 25 and records its event. The delegating convenience constructor has not finished its remaining statement yet.

title: Return the initialized object
explanation: The convenience constructor records its final event and returns. Only now does the demo receive the new reference and read its initialized fields.

fields.name: events
fields.value: base topic=Objects → focused minutes=25 → default constructor complete

title: Change state after construction
explanation: extend(5) changes the existing session from 25 to 30 minutes. It is an ordinary operation after initialization, not a second constructor call or a new object.
